## The problem

<!--
What are you trying to do that the panel does not let you do today?

better fix than the one you had in mind.
-->

<!-- A short description of how this would work from the operator's point of view. -->

## Why it matters

<!--
Who benefits and how often? A use case I can recognise ("league host needs
to enable practice-only nights on a schedule") is much easier to act on
than a generic request.
-->

## Alternatives you considered

<!-- Workarounds, other tools that solve it differently, scripts you have wired up by hand. Optional. -->
